<!-- pr-reviewer: 24d2fc09a2b931196e2d0fc0f97cb3557f870fe0 -->

Verdict: clean. The review found no blocker. The branch is mergeable. Merge it when the release gate on the cut runner is green. The reviewer read the tree at head 24d2fc09a. The reviewer ran no build and no workflow.

1. RELEASE_NOTES.md is true in each part.
   - It has a "Changes to posted programs" section. It names #1836 (PR #1866), #417 (PR #517), #418 (PR #518), #1647 (PR #1859), #1604, #1626, #1385, and the toolpath changes.
   - It has a "Not exercised on a real control" section.
   - Known issues: it says no P1 or P2 was open at the start (2026-11-15T16:09Z) and none came after. `gh issue list` for open P1 and P2 now returns none. Eleven P3 issues are open. A P3 does not hold a cut, so the notes do not list them.
   - Process changes: it lists PROCESS_VERSION 66 to 76. Issue #681 carries a bump comment for each of 66, 67, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75 and 76. The 0.20.0 notes stop at 65. No gap and no extra.
   - The claim "106 pull requests merged since 0.20.0 (19 features, 65 fixes, 22 tests, docs and process)" is correct. The first-parent log v0.20.0..head holds 106 merge commits. Title counts: 19 feat, 65 fix, 22 other.
   - The claim "the project file format stays at version 61" is correct. `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:97` sets `PROJECT_VERSION: u32 = 61`.
2. CHANGELOG.md rows match the merged PRs. The 0.21.0 block holds 65 rows, one per behaviour PR. Each row cites a PR in the merged set, and its Commit column equals that PR's merge commit. The reviewer read the `Changelog:` line of each of the 106 PR bodies. 65 rows cover them all. Eight PRs carry row text but change only tests, CI or process (for example #1750, #1790, #1826, #1899). No row is owed for them; the Process changes section carries their record. Four PRs say `Changelog: none`. Three process-bump PRs have no `Changelog:` line. No row lacks a merged PR. No `Unreleased` row is left.
3. RECOMMENDED.md has exactly one `## v0.21.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` heading. The v0.20.0 heading stands unchanged. The diff removes 83 files under `docs/decisions/` and keeps `docs/decisions/README.md`.
4. The version is 0.21.0. The root Cargo.toml `[workspace.package]` sets it. Cargo.lock shows 0.21.0 for all nine camcraft crates and for xtask. The crate manifests use `version.workspace = true`.
5. The diff against main holds only release-mechanics files: CHANGELOG.md, Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, RECOMMENDED.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, and the 83 decision-file removals. Nothing changed under crates/*/src, assets/posts, .github/workflows, or a snapshot PNG.
6. The commit chain is `docs: 0.21.0 release notes; changelog`, `chore(release): 0.21.0 - release`, and `chore(release): sync Cargo.lock to 0.21.0`. No commit body holds a closing keyword. Note only: the version bump split into two commits, so the lock sync follows the bump commit. The head tree is consistent.

<!-- pr-reviewer: bf752be65aa056f14b05df1e79729d5a9eac3b00 -->

**Delta review of PR #1936 at head bf752be65.** The previous head 24d2fc09a had a clean full review (review id 5911971710). The head moved by one commit. This review reads that commit only. It is read-only: no build, no test run, no Actions run.

**What the delta does.** Commit bf752be65 `fix(test): hold the bore's Adaptive pin to the part silhouette after #1774` changes one test file. The release gate run 43739171721 failed one test, `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, on Linux and on Windows. The test now sets Tool containment to Inside with the existing `EditOperationParams::with_area` command. The plan the test measures is then the bore, the footprint it always pinned.

**Checks.**

1. Files touched: `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs` only, +17/-3. Result: pass.
2. The commit type is `fix(test)`, a valid Conventional Commit subject. The body is truthful: it matches issue #1950 and the failed gate run. The header and the body hold no closing keyword. Each `#N` is a plain reference. Result: pass.
3. The change is test-only. No `src/` file changed. No safety law weakened. The test drives an undoable command, so it keeps "Everything Is a Command". No assert changed. The doc comment explains why the test sets the containment, and names #1774 (PR #1780) as the cause. Issue #1950 names this commit from its side, and says the default case has no test now. That is a named reason, not a silent loss. Note, not blocking: the code comment does not name #1950. A pointer to #1950 in the comment would help the next reader. Result: pass.
4. The release PR body needs no new row for this commit. A test-only commit needs no changelog row. The body already says `Changelog: none`. Nothing in the diff contradicts the release notes. Issue #1950 is `P3`, filed after the cut start; a `P3` does not hold the cut. Result: pass.
5. The PR head on GitHub is bf752be65aa056f14b05df1e79729d5a9eac3b00. The state is open and not a draft. GitHub reports mergeable UNKNOWN. Result: pass.

**Note, not blocking.** The release gate must run again on this head before the tag, per the cut procedure. This review did not build or run that gate.

**Verdict: clean.** Label set: merge-ready. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
